system.description:
You create razor-sharp origami shuriken, and launch them at your foe. Make a ranged ninjutsu attack dealing 4d4 slashing damage.

Paper Veil. If this jutsu is cast while your Paper Veil state is active, it gains the benefit of your first Canvas Type.

Explosive Veil. On a hit, the shuriken detonate, forcing the target creature, and all creatures within 10 feet of the target to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

Serrated Veil. On a hit, the affected creature makes a Constitution saving throw, gaining a rank of Bleed on a failure.

Binding Veil. On a hit, the affected creature makes a Charisma saving throw, gaining a rank of Sealed on a failure.

Weaving Veil. On a hit, you move up to your speed, and if you end your movement within range of a target, you can make one unarmed attack against them.

Origami Angel/Demon. If this jutsu is cast while in your Origami Angel/Demon state this jutsu’s range becomes Self (30-foot cone), comparing your attack result, vs the AC of all creatures in range.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost by 3, the attacks damage by 2d4 and all other damage by +1 damage die. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of conditions inflicted and unarmed attacks made by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the ranks of conditions inflicted and unarmed attacks made by +1.
